evals.prompt: We just wrapped a big investigation — traced a race condition in the payment retry queue, found the root cause was a missing idempotency key, and I had to fight the test harness for an hour because its fixture loader silently swallows setup errors. I'm stopping for the day. Reflect on this and wrap up the session.
evals.expected_output: Recognized as a session boundary ('stopping for the day' / 'wrap up'), so all three sinks are considered with handoff included. Runs sinks in order: friction first (the fixture loader silently swallowing setup errors is a concrete obstacle -> varde-friction), then knowledge harvest (the idempotency-key root cause is a durable finding -> varde-knowledge, noting the written note's path), then handoff last (varde-handoff), passing a kind: knowledge link to the just-written note rather than restating its content. reflect itself composes no friction fields, no note body, and no handoff doc — each write is done by the leaf. Report states what each sink did, with the knowledge note path and handoff id/path.
assertions: varde-friction, varde-knowledge, and varde-handoff are invoked in that order (friction and knowledge before handoff)
The handoff step passes a link to the knowledge note as a kind: knowledge link rather than embedding the note's content
reflect delegates every write to a leaf skill and does not itself author friction item fields, a knowledge note body, or the handoff document
The final report names the knowledge note path and the handoff id/path

evals.prompt: source=varde-build — closing step after building the auth-refactor plan. During the run I hit a flaky migration step that needed a manual retry, and the plan established that all new endpoints must go through the shared rate-limiter middleware.
evals.expected_output: Treated as a mid-session source=<skill> call: only friction and knowledge are considered, and handoff is NOT invoked because the session continues. Friction capture is scoped to varde-build's own run and passed as the source (the flaky migration needing a manual retry). Knowledge harvest writes the durable rate-limiter-middleware decision/pattern via varde-knowledge. No handoff doc is written. Report notes handoff was not applicable for a source= call.
assertions: varde-handoff is not invoked for this source= call
The friction capture is passed varde-build as its source and scoped to that skill's run
Only friction and knowledge sinks are considered

evals.prompt: Reflect on the last turn — I just renamed a local variable and re-ran the tests, which passed first try. Nothing surprising happened.
evals.expected_output: Assesses the work and finds nothing concrete for any sink: no obstacle or reusable technique (friction), no durable fact a future session couldn't re-derive (knowledge), and no session-boundary context worth carrying (handoff). No leaf skill is invoked and no write is made. reflect does not manufacture a friction item or a knowledge note to justify running. Report states each sink had nothing and was skipped.
assertions: No friction item, knowledge note, or handoff doc is written and no leaf skill is invoked for a write
The skill does not manufacture an item to justify running when nothing concrete occurred
The report explicitly states the sinks had nothing and were skipped
